placeholder.tags: Type a tag and press Enter...

tooltip.appCode: Unique identifier of the app across the whole platform, upper snake case. e.g. FTM, HRM_EM.
tooltip.metadata: Extended JSON information with no fixed schema.

validation.appCodeFormat: App code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. FTM, HRM_EM.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete app
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this app from the Registry? This action cannot be undone.

tooltip.serviceCode: Unique identifier of the service across the whole platform, upper snake case. e.g. HRM_EM, FLEET_MNG.
tooltip.metadata: Extended JSON information with no fixed schema.

validation.serviceCodeFormat: Service code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. HRM_EM, FLEET_MNG.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete service
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this service from the Registry? This action cannot be undone.

tooltip.serviceId: The Service that owns this domain. Only Active services are shown for selection.
tooltip.domainCode: Unique identifier of the domain within the selected Service, upper snake case. e.g. FUEL_ENTRY, EMPLOYEE.

validation.domainCodeFormat: Domain code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. FUEL_ENTRY, EMPLOYEE.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete domain
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this domain from the Registry? This action cannot be undone.

tooltip.domainId: The Domain that owns this resource.
tooltip.resourceCode: Unique identifier of the resource within the selected Domain, upper snake case. Used in the cross-service reference standard. e.g. EMPLOYEE, VEHICLE.

validation.resourceCodeFormat: Resource code must be upper snake case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. e.g. EMPLOYEE, VEHICLE.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete resource
deleteConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this resource from the Registry? This action cannot be undone.

unassignConfirm.title: Unassign
unassignConfirm.description: Are you sure you want to remove this app-service link?

structure.title: Service Structure
structure.emptySelection: Select a Service, Domain or Resource on the left to view details, or click "+" to add a new one.
